---
title: "Privacy"
---

This page says exactly what happens when you visit this site, including the
parts that are less convenient to read. It is written to be short and specific
rather than comprehensive, because a policy nobody finishes is not a policy.

**Last reviewed: 17 October 2026.**

## The short version

- The site is a static set of pages hosted by Netlify. There is no server-side
  code, no database, no account, and nothing to sign up for.
- It runs **no advertising or remarketing tags**. The only cookies are Google
  Analytics' and one that remembers your consent choice.
- **Google Analytics counts visits.** Visitors in the European Economic Area, the
  United Kingdom and Switzerland are asked first, and nothing is stored for them
  unless they accept. Everyone else is counted by default and can switch it off
  at any time with one link (see [Changing your mind](#changing-your-mind)).
- The typeface is served from this site's own domain. Fonts used to come from
  Google before you were asked; they no longer do.
- Nothing you type here reaches me. There is no form on this site.

## Who runs this site

Aravind Hebbali, based in Bengaluru, India. The contact address is the same one
in the footer of every page. If anything on this page is wrong or unclear, that
is worth telling me about.

## What is loaded from other companies

| Who | What | When | Before you are asked? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Google | Analytics 4, to count visits | Every page, unless you have switched it off | In the EEA, UK and Switzerland: **no**. Elsewhere: yes |
| Netlify | Serves the files | Every page | Yes |

**Source Sans Pro used to be the awkward one.** The Bootstrap theme this site
uses included a stylesheet rule that pulled the font from
`fonts.googleapis.com`, which reached Google before the consent banner was
loaded and necessarily disclosed your IP address in the process. The font is
now hosted on this site's own domain and that rule has been removed, so no
request to Google is made for type at all.

I am noting the change rather than quietly deleting the paragraph, because "we no
longer do the thing we used to do" is the sort of claim worth showing the work
for. The two font files are served from `/images/fonts/`: roughly 29 KB for
regular and semibold, latin subset, and they are licensed under the SIL Open Font
License, which permits self-hosting. If you are checking, this site's
Content-Security-Policy no longer permits Google Fonts at all, so a request to
either Google font host would be blocked by the browser rather than merely
avoided by convention.

The rest of the site has no third-party embeds at all — no videos, no maps, no
chat widgets, no social media buttons that load anything. Calendly and
LinkedIn appear only as ordinary links that take you to another site, and those
sites have their own policies.

## Google Analytics

Used for one purpose: knowing which pages get read. It is configured for basic
page measurement, with no advertising or conversion features.

With analytics on, a page view sends Google the page you are on and its title, the
page you came from, your approximate country and city derived from your IP
address, your browser, operating system, screen resolution and language, and an
identifier stored in a cookie so your visits can be grouped. The IP address
itself is used to work out the location and is not stored. Google's own
documentation on [what Google Analytics collects](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/13627441)
and [how location works](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/5360183)
covers this in more detail than a site policy can.

Two things you should know that are easy to miss:

- **Google Signals is switched on** for this property, which lets Google
  report aggregated demographic and interest data. Google states this data is
  not used to identify individual visitors, but the setting lives in the
  Analytics property rather than on this site, and it was on when I looked.
- **There is no advertising measurement.** No Google Ads tag is present, so no
  click identifiers are sent and your visits here are not connected to any ad
  profile I control.

**How consent works.** The site uses Google's Consent Mode. If you are in the
European Economic Area, the United Kingdom or Switzerland, analytics storage
starts as denied and a banner asks you; until you accept, no analytics cookie is
set. Your region is worked out by Google from your IP address, and the banner
itself appears when your browser's time zone is in Europe. Everywhere else,
analytics storage starts as granted. Advertising storage is denied for everyone,
always.

This is the same setup used across Rsquared Academy's sites, and the same as
`blog.aravindhebbali.com`, so one choice applies to both of my sites.

## Cookies

| Cookie | Set when | Purpose | Lifetime |
|---|---|---|---|
| `_ga`, `_ga_<ID>` | Analytics is on (by default outside Europe, or after you accept) | Distinguishes you from other visitors | 2 years |
| `rsa_consent` | You accept, decline or switch analytics off | Remembers your choice so you are not asked again, on `aravindhebbali.com` and its subdomains | 180 days |

If you decline or switch analytics off, **no analytics cookies are set**; only
`rsa_consent` remains, to remember that choice.

## Changing your mind

You can switch analytics off at any time:
<a href="#" data-rsa-analytics-optout>Turn off analytics</a>. The same link is in
the footer of every page. It stores your choice for 180 days and takes effect
straight away.

Clearing cookies and site data for `aravindhebbali.com` in your browser has the
same effect.

## Links to other sites

This site links to package documentation on CRAN and Rsquared Academy, book
downloads, GitHub repositories, LinkedIn, Calendly, and a blog. Those are plain
links: nothing is loaded from them until you click, and once you do, their own
privacy policies apply rather than this one.

## What this site does not do

No advertising. No remarketing or retargeting. No selling or sharing of data.
No behavioural profiling for ads. No third-party analytics other than the one
above. No cross-site tracking of any kind. No server logs containing personal
data beyond what Netlify records automatically for delivering files.

## Contact

Questions, corrections, or a request to delete data associated with your
visits — email me at the address in the footer. Requests about the data Google
Analytics holds are best made directly to
[Google](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/6019695), which is the
only party that can act on them; I can only stop sending new data.
